description: This file defines the SubscriptionResponse class which extends AbstractResponse and implements RedirectResponseInterface, managing responses related to Stripe subscription checkout sessions in the Omnipay integration.

classes.name: SubscriptionResponse
classes.description: A response class for handling Stripe subscription checkout session responses, providing methods to determine success, redirect URL, and transaction reference.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response with request, Stripe checkout session, and optional subscription.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if the Stripe checkout session status indicates completion.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Indicates that this response involves a redirect.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user to Stripe's checkout page.

methods.name: getTransactionReference
methods.description: Returns the invoice reference from the Stripe checkout session.
